skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id known --wait
json-value id JOB
controller quiesce
# Discovery is a view at the exact boundary; it cannot latch acceptance.
clock accept
db-save accept.db
skygo --json jobs retention
db-unchanged accept.db
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal
stdout '"executed": *false'
db-unchanged accept.db
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id absent
stderr 'request epoch expired'
clock rollback
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id absent
stderr 'request epoch expired'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id known
json-value id REPLAY
equal-env JOB REPLAY
# The first request at RetryUntil retires before it answers.
clock retry
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id known
stderr 'request epoch expired'
reopen-store
clock rollback
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id known
stderr 'request epoch expired'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id absent
stderr 'request epoch expired'
cmp starts one-start.txt
assert-native 0
assert-output 0
